avoid_supplements.name: Red Yeast Rice
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Contains lovastatin-like compounds; combined statin-fibrate therapy significantly increases rhabdomyolysis and myopathy risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; counsel patient to discontinue red yeast rice while taking fenofibrate

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Niacin (>1000 mg/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Niacin + fibrates increase myopathy risk and potentiate lipid-lowering effects unpredictably
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; if clinically necessary, use only with careful monitoring and dose adjustment

avoid_supplements.name: Cranberry supplements (high doses)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit OATP1B1 transporter, increasing fenofibrate exposure and myopathy risk
avoid_supplements.action: Advise patient to limit cranberry supplements or monitor for muscle pain/weakness

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids (fish oil)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive triglyceride-lowering effects; generally synergistic but may increase bleeding risk with high doses
caution_supplements.action: Monitor lipid panels and bleeding signs; coordinate dosing with prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild antiplatelet effects and potentiate lipid-lowering activity
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor for excessive bleeding or bruising

caution_supplements.name: Ginger supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet activity; may marginally enhance fibrate effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor clinical response; no dose adjustment typically needed

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: Inhibits CYP3A4 and OATP1B1, substantially increasing fenofibrate bioavailability and myopathy risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products; counsel patient to choose alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Fenofibrate absorption is increased with food; may lead to variable drug levels
caution_foods.action: Take fenofibrate consistently with or without food; maintain steady dietary pattern

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (>1-2 drinks/day)
caution_foods.mechanism: Chronic alcohol increases triglycerides and hepatotoxicity risk; potentiates myopathy risk
caution_foods.action: Counsel on moderate alcohol consumption; monitor liver function tests

monitoring_notes: Monitor CK levels, liver function tests (AST/ALT), and renal function at baseline and periodically, especially if patient develops muscle pain, weakness, or dark urine. Assess drug-drug interactions with concurrent statin use as combination significantly elevates myopathy risk.
